name: Helvetia
title: Grocer

merchant/30081.htm.text: Grocer Helvetia: Come in, welcome to our shop, where we always provide you with affordable, quality goods. Take your time, and if there is anything you need, just let me know.
merchant/30081.htm.dpText: Trader Helvetia: Welcome! Our shop carries a wide range of inexpensive but high-quality items. Come in, come in! Take some time and have a look around. If you need anything, just give me a shout.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate
links.dpText: View information about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30081-pk.htm.text: Grocer Helvetia: My goodness. I can't believe people like you still walk the streets. What, do the guards of Giran just spend our taxes and sleep or what? I tell you, it's a disgrace.

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-01.htm.text: Helvetia: Adventurer, you are not too busy, are you? Please help me! I promise that I will give you a generous reward.

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-02.htm.text: Helvetia: Adventurer... Oh, never mind. I'm sorry to have disturbed you. (Only characters level 40 and above may undertake this quest.)

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-05.html.text: Helvetia: There's not much time. Please go to O'Fulle and bring me the chest of fish I ordered.

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-06.html.text: Helvetia: Did you have to catch the fish yourself?! Why did it take you so long? Please give me the chest of fish right away -- my customer will be here soon!

links.text: Hand over the chest of fish.

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-08.html.text: Helvetia: There's not much time! Please go to Gesto and get the jar of seeds for me.

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-09.html.text: Helvetia: Did you have to gather the seeds yourself?! Why did it take so long? Please give me the jar of seeds right away -- my customer will be here any moment.

links.text: Hand over the jar of seeds.
"I heard that you have a wide selection of antidotes."

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/30081-04.html.text: Helvetia: I analyzed the blood you gave me. I was able to identify the poison, but I'm afraid that I can't give you the antidote for free. It's very rare, so I have to charge you. You understand, don't you? I'm sure the person you save will be happy to reimburse you. The charge is approximately 3 m…

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/30081-08.html.text: Helvetia: Did you come here looking for the antidote? If you pay me what it's worth, I'll give it to you.

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/30081-09.html.text: Helvetia: You are so careless! You lost the antidote?! Well, since you already paid me, I suppose I'll give it to you again -- just this once, you understand.

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/30081-10.html.text: Helvetia: Why are you here again? If you're not willing to buy something, kindly step aside so that I can serve my paying customers?

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-03.html.text: Helvetia: The thing is, I asked O'Fulle to bring me a chest of fish for one of my most important customers, but it's not here yet. Will you find out what's happened?

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-04.html.text: Helvetia: The thing is, I asked Warehouse Chief Gesto to bring me a jar of seeds for one of my most important customers, but it's not here yet. Will you find out what's happened?

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-07.html.text: Helvetia: Fortunately, the items look good. Thank you! Please take this cube in exchange for your hard work. Use it well!

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30081-10.html.text: Helvetia: Fortunately, the items look good. Thank you! Please take this cube in exchange for your hard work. Use it well!

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/30081-02.html.text: Helvetia: Please describe the symptoms. There are many antidotes to choose from, and we must select the right one.

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/30081-03.html.text: Helvetia: Hmm... Fortunately, the blood hasn't completely dried, so I may be able to examine it. Can you come back in a while? It will take some time to identify the specific poison at work...

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/30081-05.html.text: Helvetia: Very well. Take this potion and force the victim to drink it all. I hope we will meet again under better circumstances.

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/30081-06.html.text: Helvetia: You don't have the money! Why did you tell me that you did? Get lost!

Q00060_GoodWorksReward/30081-07.html.text: Helvetia: Look, I already told you! I can't give it to you for free. If you change your mind, come back and see me.
